subject: Final MAP alignment + go/no-go runway and signature timing
messages:
From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenretail.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Diaz <michael.diaz@lumenretail.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T14:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP alignment + go/no-go runway and signature timing

Aisha,

Thanks for the MAP draft — the team reviewed and we're close. Two quick asks before we lock:

- Can we confirm the absolute latest signer window (we have a holiday week in week 23) so Legal can route internally?
- If we sign by 2028-06-07, can Redwood guarantee a 2028-06-12 pilot start (with the 2-week onboarding buffer you outlined)?

Attached is an internal checklist that shows the stakeholders who need to sign. If you can send a final signoff matrix and the e-sign envelope timeline, we can unblock procurement.

Cheers,
Sara

--
Sara Connors
Head of Digital Ops, Lumen Retail
sara.connors@lumenretail.com
(415) 555-1942

Attachment: lumen-signers.xlsx (attachment referenced, internal checklist)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenretail.com>, Michael Diaz <michael.diaz@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-26T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP alignment + go/no-go runway and signature timing

Sara / Michael — thanks, this is helpful.

Summary of what we'll do (MAP v3 attached + SOW draft):

1) Signer window & DocuSign plan
   - DocuSign envelope prepared and ready to send: target send = 2028-06-04 09:00 PT.
   - Absolute latest fully executed signature date to meet the 06-12 pilot start: 2028-06-07 EOD (your TZ).

2) Start date & onboarding cadence
   - Pilot start: 2028-06-12 (2 business days for infra provisioning, week 1 low-risk tests, week 2 validation).
   - Contingency: If signatures slip to 06-08–06-10, we will compress provisioning and shift kickoff to 06-15 with a negotiated priority ramp.

3) Approvals needed (internal & external):
   - Lumen: Legal (Sara), Procurement (Michael), Program Sponsor (named in your checklist).
   - Redwood: Sales (me), Finance (Karthik), CS (Grace), Legal as needed for last-minute redlines.

4) Paperflow items attached:
   - Lumen_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria)
   - SOW_Redwood_Lumen_2028.docx (SOW with start/term and billing cadence)

Asks from your side: confirm that Procurement can sign by 06-07 EOD and whether any governance committee review will extend that window.

I'll loop in Karthik for the invoice/tax/PO path and Grace for onboarding readiness. If everything looks good we will send the DocuSign envelope on 06-04 and the last internal reminder on 06-06.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

Attachment: Lumen_MAP_v3.pdf; SOW_Redwood_Lumen_2028.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenretail.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP alignment + go/no-go runway and signature timing

Looping in finance/procurement notes — quick summary of items that could shift the timeline: 

- PO vs. prepay: Lumen indicated they'll issue a PO; Finance needs the PO number before invoices are generated. If PO timeline slips, billing will start on signature date but invoice will reference the PO retroactively.
- Tax/compliance: We verified the nexus for their billing address; no special tax hold expected.
- Redlines: Legal flagged two small redlines in section 4 (data retention, audit logs) but we have a Legal-approved compromise clause ready; will attach a tracked-change SOW if they accept.

Operational ask: if they need a hard 06-12 start, we should require execution by 06-07 EOD with PO number by 06-10 to avoid the compressed kickoff. Otherwise propose start 06-15.

I'll prepare the invoice-ops checklist and a one-page acceptance ticklist for the envelope cover note.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: invoice-ops-checklist.pdf (will be attached in follow-up)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenretail.com>, Michael Diaz <michael.diaz@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final MAP alignment + go/no-go runway and signature timing

Sara / Michael — quick go/no-go note and next steps (final):

- Go decision: We will treat 2028-06-07 EOD as the final go/no-go checkpoint. If fully executed by then, Redwood will meet pilot start 2028-06-12.
- DocuSign: We will send the envelope on 2028-06-04 09:00 PT; signers should expect reminders on 06-05 and 06-06. Envelope will include a cover note with the acceptance checklist and where to enter the PO number.
- Attachment & flow: Attached MAP v3 and SOW (same as prior); Karthik will send the invoice ops checklist and Grace will share the onboarding preflight doc during week-of provisioning.

If any governance committee pushes the signature past 06-07, please flag immediately so we can replan for a 06-15 start and agree the compressed onboarding checklist.

I'll send the DocuSign envelope once I have confirmation that Procurement will not require an additional legal review meeting. If you confirm now, I will proceed with 06-04 send.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
